'''Balfron''' was a small terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It had several casinos where planets could be won or lost in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], including [[The High Stakes Casino]], where [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] arranged for [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to meet the [[Tonnika sisters/Legends|Tonnika sisters]] as part of an elaborate prank.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Despite placing the planet in the Dolomar Sector, the in-game encyclopedia entry for Balfron in the PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] claims it is located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
